conviction_note: The only thing I found is that BB has cleared the top of its own revenue guide by 5-9% in every recent print, so revenue of about $150-155M against a $145.5M consensus is the base case (print_vs_bar +5%). But the wire already carries that record, the -34 vol-point call skew and 'extremely bullish' retail already price it, and the stock gave back all of June's +20% within eight weeks. So the reaction is sized at +0.3, below the +0.5 finding and far below the 12.4% implied move: close to an honest zero.
bar: Company Q2 FY27 guide: revenue $137-148M (midpoint $142.5M), non-GAAP EPS $0.03-0.04, QNX $70-75M, Secure Comms $57-63M, Licensing ~$10M (https://www.newswire.com/news/blackberry-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-year-2027-results, 2026-06-25). Consensus revenue is $143M per Zacks (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/blackberry-report-q2-results-investors-145200681.html, 2026-09-22) and $145.53M per Stocktwits/RBC (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/black-berry-stock-jumps-ahead-of-earnings-analyst-sees-potential-revenue-and-eps-beats/cZMP41HRBIA). Consensus EPS is $0.04. The guide sources the bar, so no cap applies. Sized against $145.5M.
positioning_check: Short interest was 36.18M shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement, down 0.73M from 08-14, with 3.97 days to cover on 9.11M average volume (https://www.theonlineinvestor.com/short-interest/bb/). That is about 6% of float. The sweep also found a conflicting 2.96% of float / 7.68 days (fintel, snippet only). Either way it is not a crowded short. Skew is -34.31 vol points (calls far richer than puts) and put/call OI is 0.47: the market is paying loudly for upside. Retail sentiment on Stocktwits is 'extremely bullish'. The stock is +7.0% over 5 days on the 09-22 Coretura win, but 35% below its late-June high of about $13.

findings.finding: BB has beaten the top of its own revenue guide in each of the last four prints: Q2 FY26 above the top on both segments; Q3 FY26 $141.8M above the top; Q4 FY26 $156.0M against $138-148M; Q1 FY27 $152.9M against $132-140M, with QNX $72.3M against $60-64M. On that record, Q2 FY27 revenue of roughly $150-155M against the $148M top and the $145.5M consensus is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats above the top of the guide were bought three times and sold once. 2026-06-25: 9% over the top with an FY raise, +19.95%, then all of it given back and more by August ($13.59 on 06-29 to $7.65 on 08-24). 2026-04-09: Q4 5% over the top, +8.22%. 2025-09-25: beat on both segments with a raise, +8.9%. 2025-12-18: beat over the top with a raised outlook, -12.93% on slowing QNX growth. So the line pays mostly through QNX growth and the FY guide, not through the headline beat.
findings.why_not_priced: It mostly is priced. If the market had fully priced a $152M+ print, consensus would sit above the $148M guide top rather than at $143-145.5M. Instead, the options already pay for upside (-34 skew, 12.4% implied move), retail is extremely bullish, and Zacks prints the four-quarter beat record. The only residual is that estimates still anchor inside the guide.
findings.independence: The Q1 FY27 guide-versus-actual comes from a different document (https://www.newswire.com/news/blackberry-reports-first-quarter-fiscal-year-2027-results) and points the same way. But this is one pattern, not two findings. Against it: Q2 Secure Comms is guided down to $57-63M from $73.6M after Canada's upfront recognition, and Q1's QNX beat rested on development licenses at an eight-quarter high, which are lumpy (https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_BB_2026-06-25). That is why the size is small.

outside_window.finding: Coretura (the Daimler Truck/Volvo venture) picked Alloy Kore, adding over $100M to QNX's estimated royalty backlog. Those royalties arrive years out and depend on production. The announcement itself was priced on 2026-09-22 (+7%).

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR filings since 2026-06-01 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001070235.json): only the 09-22 Coretura 8-K (item 8.01), routine Form 4s, and July Form 144s (CEO plan to sell 125k shares), which are immaterial.

Convertible notes: the 3% 2029 notes ($3.88 conversion) became convertible for 2026-07-01 to 09-30 (10-Q subsequent events, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001070235/000107023526000076/bbry-20260531.htm). Diluted EPS already carries them, and nothing is dated in the window.
Q1 10-Q footnotes: deferred revenue fell $152.6M to $133.9M; the Arctic Wolf stake sits in $57.8M of non-marketable equity with a $0.5M impairment. Nothing lands on Q2 or the guide.

Secure Comms government awards for June-August 2026: no new awards found beyond the March 2026 Canada SSC renewal (https://www.canada.ca/en/shared-services/news/2026/03/blackberry-secusuite-contract.html).
Malikie patent licensing: early-2026 settlements are confidential, and licensing is about $10M of revenue.
Global auto production (S&P Global Mobility June/August 2026): China cut, Europe raised. This is a macro proxy and not transmissible to QNX without a company or counterparty statement.
Layoffs or hiring changes in summer 2026: none found.
baseline_tension: What I found agrees with the skew (calls rich) and the 5-day run-up, so it is essentially already in the price. Nothing I found cuts against them.
lessons_applied: Lessons 1 and 7: the finding lands on the reported quarter and agrees with a -34 call skew. The reaction history shows a beat-plus-raise sold -12.9%, and the June +20% fully unwound, so the finding was cut from +1.5 to +0.5 and the expected move from +1.0 to +0.3.
'What has worked': the beat-over-guide record is aggregator-carried (Zacks prints it), not a primary-document number nobody carries, which is a further reason for the small size.
Lesson 6: the bar was checked against the company guide plus two estimate sources ($143M and $145.53M, which differ slightly). Sized against $145.5M; no cap needed.
Lesson 9: the finding is net of Secure Comms being guided down about 18% sequentially after Canada. The beat case rests on QNX, and that is stated in independence.
Left standing: print_vs_bar_pct at +5.0; Coretura kept in outside_window.
